standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme theoretic density characterized by injectivity of the pushforward of the structure sheaf
standard_prerequisites.use: Is the criterion applied twice, once for each of U and V, and once for the conclusion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale localization of the density condition
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the claim to the displayed chain of restriction maps.

core_obligations: Let W -> X be etale and consider the chain O(W) -> O(W x_X V) -> O(W x_X (V intersect U)) (proof lines 3558-3561).
Use the density characterization for V and for U to see that both maps are injective (proof lines 3562-3563).
Conclude that the composite is injective, hence that the intersection is scheme theoretically dense (proof lines 3563-3565).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if U and V are scheme theoretically dense open subspaces of an algebraic space X over S, then so is their intersection (source lines 3551-3556). The proof uses the characterization of scheme theoretic density by injectivity of O_X -> j_*O_U on etale objects: for an etale W -> X the restriction map O(W) -> O(W x_X V) -> O(W x_X (V intersect U)) is a composite of two injective maps, hence injective, and the characterization gives the conclusion.
